design.source_policy: exclude 616 previous real source hashes and paths; 36 fresh admitted numeric-copy examples and 64 synthetic balanced arbitrary associations; pinned G7 remaining replay reserve 17 before selection, fail closed if insufficient
design.probes: two actual shadow AdamW protected-displacement probes per trial from same pretrial model/optimizer snapshot, same gradient, same constraints, same learning rate; both rolled back and digest verified; at most one admissible saved model and optimizer committed exactly
design.feedback: raw prediction normalized share of nonnegative projected objective descent; corrected score = clamp(raw share + per-block EWMA error,0,1); error update .8 old + .2(observed share minus raw share) on informative trials; reward feasible current-gate CE gain or zero for veto; no update if both rewards zero; prechoice frozen before probes for calibrated and random arms; observed-best chooses after probes, diagnostic oracle not prospective prediction
design.memory: record both offers, gain, flags, projection, raw and corrected shares, before/after error, chosen and observed-best block in metrics artifact per trial; no cross-run persistent learner yet
design.geometry: unchanged R121 frozen group metric and capped expansion .5/.625/.75, full original retention checks plus actual step>=1e-6 and CE gain>=1e-6
design.evaluation: report regret relative to best feasible offer at same states, raw vs corrected share MAE on informative trials, ranking correctness on decisive trials, switches and block counts, accepted updates, held-out exact generated answers and all historical and old losses; separate final exam with unchanged criteria, no promotion

limits: Calibration score is relative predicted gain, not a probability or proof of understanding; CE reward surrogate differs from exact answer correctness
Observed-best uses internal gate lookahead and serves as local oracle; not blind future prediction
Raw predictor is a diagnostic on same states, not independent raw-prediction training arm; trajectories differ across arms
Error memory exists within a run and metrics archive, not yet cross-generation inheritance
New source reserve may be insufficient; no admission relaxation or reuse of previous exam sources
No external independent blind exam, production mutation or candidate export
